purpose: Deterministic Inspector / Action / Reference cases over the Species-aware appearance foundation. These cases are explicitly QA fixtures and do not create Species canon beyond cited source/owner decisions.
coverage_rules: Every P06 projection group must appear in at least one new case.
Every P06 governed action must appear in at least one new case.
Inherited 36 Species Visual cases remain regression inputs and are not replaced.
Special Species profile guards must be tested for both valid and rejected operations where applicable.
Accessibility and permission behavior is semantic, not screenshot-only.

cases.name: human_snapshot
cases.expected: Returns semantic snapshot without assuming hidden/unavailable fields.

cases.name: vespin_morphology
cases.expected: Shows 4 arms, 2 legs, wings, abdomen/stinger; never collapses to humanoid two-arm graph.

cases.name: suula_live_biology
cases.scenario: Suula with persistent adaptation and active adaptation
cases.expected: Persistent marker and active overlay are visible when authorized and read-only.

cases.name: arborae_profiles
cases.expected: Returns four editable seasonal profiles and upstream current season selector.

cases.name: rakuuta_layers
cases.expected: Required black raven-shaped facial feather field remains present and labeled as feathers, not horns.

cases.name: wardrobe_catalog
cases.expected: Returns only compatible nonmechanical presentation assets; mechanics_granted=false.

cases.name: equipment_projection
cases.expected: Shows compatible visual projection without changing inventory/equipment state.

cases.name: manytoms_renderer
cases.expected: Coverage is evaluated for cohesive composite rendering and does not require exactly seventeen visible sprites.

cases.name: view_support
cases.expected: Returns 3/4 full-body, portrait/zoom and token support; arbitrary rotation is false.

cases.name: preset_library
cases.expected: Returns compatible presets using stable semantic IDs and profile scopes.

cases.name: furashin_art_provenance
cases.expected: Returns Furashin owner-confirmed Species binding while filename/prompt label is explicitly non-authoritative.

cases.name: screen_reader_summary
cases.expected: Returns structured summary, support state and changed-field text with no color-only status.

cases.name: compatible_choices_gray
cases.expected: Hair and external-ear options are absent; compatible authored choices remain source bounded.

cases.name: preview_toba_dye
cases.expected: Cosmetic dye changes preview while natural biological fur channel remains separate.

cases.name: mythragara_hybrid
cases.expected: Hybrid derives deterministically from authored base/animal identities and cannot become independent authority.

cases.name: furashin_randomize
cases.expected: Proposal respects locks and produces no more than three fur colors; source-owned fields untouched.

cases.name: foreign_species_preset
cases.expected: Different morphology is classified incompatible/partially recoverable rather than coerced.

cases.name: moravi_asset_gap
cases.expected: Missing four-leg anchor/asset reports partial or unsupported; Character remains valid.

cases.name: vespin_wardrobe_fit
cases.expected: Two-arm garment without four-arm variant reports unsupported; no asset warping.

cases.name: stygian_equipment_fit
cases.expected: Equipment visual fit may report conflict with wing anchors without changing wing biology/equipment state.

cases.name: nonvisual_comparison
cases.expected: Returns semantic differences in text, including material/pattern differences independent of color.

cases.name: ambiguous_recovery
cases.expected: Proposes operation-status/current-version/receipt checks before any retry.

cases.name: set_orc_tusk
cases.expected: Authorized appearance write changes optional visible-tusk choice only and returns versioned receipt.

cases.name: set_arborae_winter
cases.scenario: Set Arborae winter profile bark intensity
cases.expected: Writes only winter profile override; current season remains upstream.

cases.name: accept_randomization
cases.expected: Requires authorization, expected_version and operation_id; commits only proposed eligible authored fields.

cases.name: save_preset
cases.expected: Stores stable semantic/choice IDs and versions; source-owned biology excluded.

cases.name: apply_preset
cases.expected: Applies compatible authored subset through versioned mutation and leaves equipment/biology unchanged.

cases.name: import_preset
cases.expected: Commits only explicitly approved compatible subset after compatibility report.

cases.name: set_wardrobe
cases.expected: Changes cosmetic presentation item; inventory and mechanics remain unchanged.

cases.name: set_pose
cases.expected: Writes supported presentation pose/expression only; no mechanical stance effect.

cases.name: nekron_pretransition
cases.scenario: Attempt to edit post-transition Nekron before transition
cases.expected: Rejected because transition state does not exist; appearance cannot trigger ascension.

cases.name: suula_delete_marker
cases.scenario: Attempt to erase Suula adaptation marker
cases.expected: Rejected as source-owned persistent history; cosmetic neighboring fields remain available.

cases.name: stygian_add_wings
cases.scenario: Attempt to add wings without upstream wing morphology
cases.expected: Wing visual choice is unavailable; appearance cannot create flight-capable anatomy.

cases.name: the_free_nonhumanoid
cases.scenario: Attempt to make The Free quadrupedal
cases.expected: Rejected by broad-humanoid android grammar; configurable android design remains wide within humanoid topology.

cases.name: gray_hair_preset
cases.scenario: Import preset containing hair onto Gray
cases.expected: Hair field classified incompatible and not silently substituted.

cases.name: manytoms_preset
cases.expected: Serializes one constituent identity plus collective presentation preference, not seventeen identities.

cases.name: kola_form
cases.expected: Current Form overlay changes visible anatomy from upstream projection while baseline appearance remains preserved.

cases.name: traiga_covering
cases.expected: Compatible source-authorized feathered/scaled/mixed choices appear; no extra wing pair is synthesized.

cases.name: dwarf_beard
cases.expected: Beard choices remain available independent of sex/gender field.

cases.name: giantkin_names
cases.expected: Only Grendelkin, Surtrborn and Daityr appear; legacy names do not become choices.

cases.name: equipment_missing_asset
cases.scenario: Actual equipment has no compatible visual asset
cases.expected: Preview says unavailable/unsupported; item remains equipped in owning system and Character remains valid.

cases.name: hidden_marker
cases.expected: Marker is filtered before summary, renderer diagnostics, preset/export and AI context; no derivative leak.

cases.name: mobile
cases.expected: All semantic sections and commit/randomize/view actions remain reachable with stacked/switching layout.

cases.name: keyboard
cases.expected: All controls, categories, presets, randomize, view switching and commit actions have deterministic focus/activation.

cases.name: screenreader_change
cases.expected: Changed semantic fields are announced; visual preview is not required to understand result.

cases.name: stale_version
cases.expected: Mutation rejects safely with current version and requires re-preview/rebase; no partial change.

cases.name: duplicate_operation
cases.expected: Compatible duplicate converges on prior receipt and does not double-apply appearance change.

cases.name: unsupported_view
cases.scenario: Topology supports full body but token asset missing
cases.expected: View support reports token partial/unsupported while full-body/portrait remain available and Character validity is unchanged.
